clue.text: Player's skill changed his aims in cup

indicators.note: something changed has been altered, so the letters that follow are put into a new order

parts.note: all twelve letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A sportsman's ability transformed his ambitions in a cup competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Musicianship is the ability of a performer on an instrument, a player in the musical sense.

clue.text: Doctor with obligations guarding against inducements

parts.note: MO is a medical officer

indicators.note: to guard something is to surround and protect it, so one piece holds another

parts.note: ties are bonds or obligations
V for versus

explanation.surface: A doctor with professional obligations resists being offered incentives.
explanation.definitionFit: Motives are the reasons that prompt action, much as inducements are things that prompt someone to act.

clue.text: Produce small puppet

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a pawn is someone used as a puppet by others

explanation.surface: An instruction to make a little marionette.
explanation.definitionFit: To spawn is to generate or give rise to, a synonym of the verb produce.

clue.text: Novelist's plan involving group on river and volcano mostly written up

indicators.note: to involve is to include within, so the plan takes the group inside it

parts.note: a chart is a plan or map
a lot is a group or batch
the Ebro is a river in Spain

indicators.note: in a down clue, writing something upwards reads it from bottom to top
mostly means not quite all, so the final letter of the volcano is dropped

parts.note: Etna is the volcano on Sicily

explanation.surface: A writer's scheme involves a party on a river trip and a volcano, which she then writes about.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means placed above, so the group sits over the Spanish river; 'written up' likewise reverses only because the answer runs downwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte Brontë was the English author of Jane Eyre, a famous novelist.

clue.text: Revised main warning about force in allegory

indicators.note: a revised text has been reworked, so the word that follows is rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means around, so the warning is wrapped round the letter for force

parts.note: an alarm is a warning
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: An updated chief caution about the use of force appears in a symbolic tale.
explanation.definitionFit: Orwell's Animal Farm is a political allegory of the Russian Revolution told through farm animals.

clue.text: Dry time for religious group

parts.note: sec describes dry wine
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A spell without alcohol imposed on a religious community.
explanation.definitionFit: A sect is a breakaway faction or denomination within a faith.

clue.text: Rapturous vein then has to be modified to keep calm

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it, so the rearranged letters hold another word
things that are modified are altered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: letters taken as written
even means calm and steady, as in an even temper

explanation.surface: An instruction that a rapturous streak has to be toned down to stay calm.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in seventh heaven is an idiom for a state of supreme happiness or bliss.

clue.text: Room in church designed as crypt is lacking power

indicators.note: something designed is laid out afresh, so the letters are put in a new order
lacking means going without, so one letter is taken out

parts.note: letters taken as written
P is the abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: A church room built like a crypt is short of electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacristy is the vestry where a church keeps its vestments and sacred vessels.

clue.text: Escort at first in touch with purpose

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word it qualifies

parts.note: the opening letter of touch
an end is an aim or purpose

explanation.surface: A companion who keeps in contact from the start, with a goal in mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend someone is to accompany or wait on them, as an escort does.

clue.text: Headdress and odd items from trip abroad

indicators.note: odd items are those in the first, third, fifth positions and so on

parts.note: the letters in odd positions

explanation.surface: A head-piece and some miscellaneous souvenirs picked up on a holiday overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental band worn on the head.

clue.text: Persistent soldier perhaps following royal female, ignoring public relations

indicators.note: to ignore something is to leave it out, so those letters are dropped
following means coming behind, so the soldier is placed after the royal female

parts.note: a princess is a female royal
a soldier ant is one kind of ant, hence 'perhaps'
PR is the abbreviation for public relations

explanation.surface: A dogged soldier trails a princess while steering clear of the press office.
explanation.definitionFit: Incessant means continuing without pause, which is what persistent describes.

clue.text: Ordinary article in house

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a villa is a house
the indefinite article before a vowel

explanation.surface: A mundane item found around the home.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanilla is informal for plain or standard, with no extras, from the default ice-cream flavour.

clue.text: States Spain opposed

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Several nations say Spain is against something.
explanation.definitionFit: Averse means having a strong dislike or opposition, as in averse to change.

clue.text: Unravel oddly absorbing account, ending in your everyday language

indicators.note: to absorb is to take in, so the jumbled letters hold another piece
oddly means in a strange manner, so the word's letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
AC is the abbreviation for account

indicators.note: the ending of a word is its last letter

parts.note: the final letter of your

explanation.surface: Untangle, in an odd way, a story that takes in your normal speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' tempts a solver to take alternate letters, but here it means strangely, an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The vernacular is the ordinary spoken speech of a region, as opposed to formal or literary language.

clue.text: Cross, missing northern resort

indicators.note: missing means without, so the letter for northern is removed

parts.note: to span is to cross, as a bridge does
N is the abbreviation for northern

explanation.surface: Annoyed at not getting to a holiday destination in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' reads as angry, but it is the verb to traverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a town with mineral springs that people visit for health, a type of resort.

clue.text: Lose support of knight, put away after a deception

indicators.note: after means coming later, so the knight and the eating are placed behind the opening pair

parts.note: taken as written
a lie is a deception
N is the chess notation for knight
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: A knight forfeits backing after being caught out in a lie.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate people is to estrange them, turning former backers against you.

clue.text: Supercilious in charge, having fresh food sent round

indicators.note: in places the charge inside the other letters
round means surrounding, so the reworked letters go about the charge
fresh means new, so the letters of the words after it are made anew

parts.note: letters taken as written
a fee is a charge

explanation.surface: A haughty manager has a new meal delivered.
explanation.walkthrough: Toffee-nosed is British slang for snobbish, from a toff, an upper-class person.
explanation.definitionFit: Toffee-nosed describes someone stuck-up and disdainful, a synonym of supercilious.

clue.text: Bit of wood used for mending fences?

definitions.text: Bit of wood used for mending fences?

parts.words: Bit of wood used for mending fences?
parts.note: surface reading: a piece of timber used to repair a garden fence; setter's reading: mending fences is an idiom for making peace after a quarrel, and the bit of wood is a twig offered as a peace token

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a carpenter's offcut; the idiom 'mending fences' turns it into reconciliation.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding out a twig from this tree is a traditional symbol of offering peace to an opponent.

clue.text: Interest people hold

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to engage or absorb someone's attention
second meaning: what people do to territory they take and keep

explanation.surface: A claim that a stake is what the public has.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both keeping someone busy or engaged and taking possession of a place.

clue.text: Vegetable from month back

indicators.note: going back means travelling in the opposite direction, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: May is a month

explanation.surface: Produce from the garden harvested last month.
explanation.definitionFit: A yam is a starchy edible tuber, a root vegetable.

clue.text: Insect problem upset horse

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters read from the bottom up

parts.note: a gnat is an insect
a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: A troublesome bug bothered a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A mustang is a wild or feral horse of the American plains.

clue.text: Songbird is able to change, leaving out verse

parts.note: can means is able

indicators.note: leaving something out means omitting it, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: to vary is to change
V is the abbreviation for verse

explanation.surface: A singing bird can alter its tune by dropping a stanza.
explanation.definitionFit: The canary is a small yellow finch kept as a pet for its singing.

clue.text: Lines about entering into legal actions

indicators.note: to enter into something is to go inside it

parts.note: cases are lawsuits
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Wording on a topic gets entered into lawsuits.

explanation.definitionFit: Creases are folds or wrinkles, lines pressed into cloth, paper or skin.

clue.text: Japanese food coming in pleases us highly

indicators.note: coming in says the answer lies within the words that follow

parts.note: runs across the end of the first word, all of the second and the start of the third

explanation.surface: A Japanese dish arrives and delights us greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sushi is a Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish or other toppings.

clue.text: Support lord in speech

indicators.note: in speech means when spoken out, so we go by sound and not spelling

parts.note: a peer is a member of the nobility, such as a lord

clue.text: Promise prize, late in being arranged

parts.note: a pot is a prize or trophy

indicators.note: arranging puts things in a new order, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A pledge of a reward, arriving late, is being organised.
explanation.definitionFit: Promise, as in showing promise, is latent capacity for future success, which is what potential means.

clue.text: Scene caused by saint breaking through

indicators.note: breaking into something means getting inside it

parts.note: via means by way of, through

explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a pleasing view or panorama, a scene laid out before the eye.

clue.text: Fashion in a sense is tragic

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: hearing is one of the five senses
a trend is a fashion

explanation.surface: Following style in a certain way is a sad affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heart-rending causes deep grief, as a tragic event does.
